run_train_model: run the fairseq training CLI to train a new model on one or multiple GPUs
run_distributed_training: run distributed training across multiple GPUs using torch multiprocessing spawn
run_validate_model: run validation on specified subsets and return validation losses for checkpointing
run_train_epoch: run training for one epoch with batch grouping and progress bar logging
run_get_training_stats: run get_training_stats to collect loss, perplexity, learning rate, and wall time metrics
